description:
Employer superannuation contribution tax (ESCT) on a New Zealand employer's KiwiSaver contribution.

    Use for: 'esct rates', 'esct calculator', 'esct tax rates nz', 'how much
    esct do I pay', 'employer kiwisaver tax', 'what is esct'.

    THE BAND IS SET ON SALARY PLUS THE EMPLOYER'S GROSS CONTRIBUTIONS, not on
    salary alone (IR340). $62,700 at 3.5% is $64,894.50, which is in the 30% band,
    not 17.5%. Bands from 1 April 2026: 10.5% to $18,720, 17.5% to $64,200, 30% to
    $93,720, 33% to $216,000, 39% above.

    Args:
        annual_salary: Gross salary or wages for the year.
        employer_contribution_rate_percent: Employer contribution, % of salary.
        pay_frequency: weekly, fortnightly, monthly or annual.
        defined_benefit_flat_rate: True for the flat 39% defined benefit rate.

    Returns:
        The ESCT rate and band, and the contribution before and after ESCT,
        yearly and per pay.
name: nz_esct_calculator
